info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Suitability Checking API
info.description: The Suitability Checking API supports financial institutions in assessing investment suitability for clients based on their profiles and market conditions. By leveraging this endpoint, users can submit client information and receive evaluations that ensure compliance with regulatory standards. Typical consumers include wealth management firms, financial advisors, and robo-advisory platforms seeking to enhance client trust and operational efficiency. The API facilitates decision-making processes related to investment products and services, thereby optimizing the client-advisor relationship.
